decision_rule.no_gate_number: No threshold is pre-registered on any of the six, because this cell carries no admission verdict: a low parse rate, a degenerate node distribution or a zero revision share is a FORM defect that stops the arm and is root-caused, not a measured result. The smoke's own acceptance is the same six items on 4 contacts; a failed smoke stops the arm and it does not open.
decision_rule.rule: STRUCTURAL ONLY. No effectiveness claim is read from this cell -- the effect of the curated deltas is read at CELL-1-GEPA, against the plan's own null. Acceptance here is: (1) PARSE RATE -- the fraction of contacts whose response yields at least one LEGAL block under rails.stage3_gepa.parse_gepa_proposal, reported with its denominator; (2) NODE DISCIPLINE -- the count of blocks whose NODE differs from the group's own node, the invariant only this arm's parser enforces; (3) ILLEGAL-BLOCK COUNT by the parser's own reason strings, retained and never repaired; (4) BLOCKS PER CONTACT -- the one-to-five distribution; (5) REVISION SHARE -- accepted proposals the curator absorbed into an existing row against those that entered as new rows, which is the number that says whether a reflective proposer reflected on the text it was shown; (6) a clean seal with row accounting in = out.

failure_policy: Stop on the first failure and preserve every contact; no retry. This cell is TEXT-ONLY (construction-advantage-text) and spends one contact per group, so a failed group is dropped from the curation input, counted, never silently retried.

They are rendered into the instruction and nowhere else, and the same rule is applied again to every proposal at curation.
leakage_rule.gate: contracts.gate_exposure._require_construction_role_for_visible_targets: the arm is construction-visible, so the FLYING cell's split identity must be that of a committed roster_role='construction' roster of carrier slurp on a discovery split. Both cells carry their own receipt.
leakage_rule.narrowing: rails.core_client.FrozenCoreClient binds the UNION of every group's rows once, at construction, and each request names EXACTLY its own group's ordered rows; an id the bound tuple does not carry is refused. A request can only ever narrow.
leakage_rule.no_evaluation_contact: nothing of this contact reaches an evaluated row: its output is an artifact, and the store's effect is measured on TRAIN Fold A at CELL-1-GEPA.
leakage_rule.nothing_is_sealed_but_identity: GepaContact.as_json records ids, counts and digests only -- group id, scenario, node, carrier, the group's row ids, the current delta value ids, per-row answer/gold digests and label counts, and the prompt sha256 and length. The rendered instruction is never a receipt field.
leakage_rule.shown_population: every one of the 173 distinct GROUP rows whose gold is rendered is an item of the committed R01C parent receipt; the groups builder refuses outright if an eligible row is not. The gate proves the FLOWN split; this proves the SHOWN population.

stage3_algorithm.note: GEPA's reflective mutation operator and nothing else: one contact per (scenario, node) group reflects over that scenario's worst- and best-outcome ROLL-1 rows -- their whole sealed trajectories -- together with the node's current delta statements, and proposes one to five revised or new statements for that node. credit_assignment because the contrast that drives the proposal is between ROWS of one scenario rather than between the samples of one row (Training-Free GRPO's unit); update because the reflection IS the mutation of the instruction text, unlike ADV-1 where the curator composes the update from per-row statements. The SELECTION operator is not exercised here: survivors are chosen by the decision-83 per-scenario frontier rule (scripts/build_slurp_stage3_delta_retention.py) over the CELL-1 read at curation, and the new rows' own outcome is read at CELL-1-GEPA. Rollout source: cell ROLL-1 (algorithm shared-rollout, run SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLLOUT-R01-V1, attempt attempt-slurp-native-stage3-rollout-r01-generation-v1) on the clean construction subset R01C.

what_is_frozen.base: No base plan and no factor: this is a CONSTRUCTION contact, not an arm of the locked v2.0 default plan. What is registered is the contact form -- arm construction-advantage-text, program phase-stage3-gepa-v1, the two pinned templates, the stage3-gepa-proposal-v1 response format, evidence_source none and scorers ['cost'] -- on the same frozen core and the same resident SLURP geometry cell PLAN, cell ROLL-1 and cell ADV-1 fly.

lines: NODE: <the group's own node; any other node is retained and marked illegal>
DELTA-KIND: <intent-boundary | slot-contract | exemplar-note | perception-hint | reviewer-criterion | planner-rule>
TARGET: <the scenario_action or slot type this statement is about>
block_form.node_invariant: the ONE invariant this parser adds to its ADV-1 sibling: a GEPA contact is addressed to exactly one node, so a block naming another node is RETAINED and marked illegal rather than silently routed into that other node's slice of the store.
block_form.revised_versus_new: decided by the CURATOR, not by a self-report: a proposal whose normalised text matches an existing store row under the exact-normalised or token-Jaccard >= 0.8 rule is absorbed into that survivor with its provenance merged (a REVISION); anything else enters as a new row. The block form carries no 'this revises X' field because nothing downstream could check one.
block_form.shape: one to five four-line blocks (MAX_GEPA_BLOCKS = 5; a sixth and later block is RETAINED and marked illegal, never silently dropped)

what_is_frozen.declared_keys_that_are_not_factors: native_episode.finite_completion_policy and native_episode.react_exhaustion_policy are NOT declared here and are not owed: this cell carries no native_episode at all (it is a one-phase phase program, not the grouped-Solver graph), so scripts/checks/finite_completion_policy_check.py has no native cell to check. stage3_algorithm (owner decision 101) IS declared: gepa-reflective-pareto-v1, operators credit_assignment + update.
what_is_frozen.purpose: Stage-3 layer A, the GEPA arm (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-24-slurp-stage3-gepa-arm-design.md; owner decision 101): ONE reflective contact per (scenario, node) group -- 17 scenarios x 4 nodes = 68 contacts -- asking the frozen core to revise and extend one node's standing guidance for one scenario from that scenario's worst- and best-outcome ROLL-1 trajectories. No answer to any evaluated row is produced or read here and no effectiveness claim is made.
